Hi — Fahad here, AI engineer in Dhaka.

I've been researching English training centres in Bangladesh, and Enhance English BD with British Council & Pearson certification is a strong positioning. The biggest leak in education businesses is usually in lead conversion — students enquire about courses via phone or Facebook, but there's no automated way to qualify them (what's their current level? what's their target? when do they need it?) before a counsellor spends time on a call.

Here's the pattern I see: a student messages your Facebook page asking about IELTS or spoken English courses. Right now, someone manually replies, asks about their goals and current level, schedules a placement test, and follows up. That's a lot of manual coordination, and leads go cold when replies are delayed by even a few hours.

I built an AI education consultant agent that handles enquiries 24/7 — it asks about learning goals, current level, preferred schedule, and budget, then recommends the right course, schedules a placement test, and sends automated reminders. It also follows up with students who enquired but didn't enrol.

Happy to show you a working demo in 15 minutes. No commitment.

Best,
Fahad
